Name: Secret Garden Frog Terrarium
Author: SugarSugarRuin
Description:
[center]﻿[color=#ff0000][u][font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Please do NOT redistribute/re-upload ANY of my mods to other websites, and

﻿I wanted Sebby's frog terrarium to match my farmhouse interior recolor, but couldn't find one anywhere, so I decided to make one.

[color=#b6d7a8][b][i]Furniture mods I use (and hence this mod is designed to match with):[/i][/b][/color]

[list]
[*][i]Mioudew's Elegant Victorian Furniture[/i]
[*][i]Mi's and Magimatica Country Furniture[/i]
[*][i]Yellog's Dark Brown and Cream Furniture[/i]
[*][i]DustBeauty's Industrial Furniture Set[/i]
[*][i]DustBeauty's Rustic Country Walls and Floors[/i]
[/list]
[b][i][color=#b6d7a8]Config Options:[/color]

[/i][/b]6 configurable options: blue, purple, pink, white, yellow or plain (no flowers)[b][i]
[/i][/b]Config.json will be generated after you run the game with the mod installed.
You can change options using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, or by editing config.json manually.
[b][i][/i][/b]
[color=#b6d7a8][b][i]Installation:[/i][/b][/color]

Extract under Mods folder. To uninstall, remove from Mods folder.
Requires Content Patcher.
[b]
[color=#b6d7a8][i]Compatibility:[/i][/color][/b]

This mod will not be compatible with any other mod that modifies the terrarium.

If you want the terrarium as a standalone furniture item, check out this mod here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8031]Craftable Terrarium[/url]﻿[/center]
[center]﻿[/center]
